children.description:
During the pandemic, the daily percentage change in time spent away from home in the United States has shown a downward trend. The data indicates that there was a significant decrease in mobility starting from around March 16, 2020. The daily average percentage change in small businesses open has also experienced fluctuations, with some days showing negative growth and others showing positive growth. Additionally, the daily percentage change in time spent at retail and recreation establishments and at parks has shown a similar declining trend as the time spent away from home. Overall, the economic impact of the pandemic has led to reduced mobility and changes in small business operations.

Now, I will give you the final answer.
